```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising parser comment states -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <child>&internal;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY copy "Copyright 2024">
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction value"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://xml.org/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       spanning several lines with -- hyphens inside -->
  <record xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[First CDATA block with © entity reference literal.]]>
  </record>
  <record>
    <![CDATA[Second CDATA block with <tags> and entities ©]]>
  </record>
  <meta>©</meta>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item code ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; & Extended">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ent 'MacroValue'>">
  %dtd-macro;
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active" version="1.0"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA and entities -->
  <item code="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block 1: &complex; and &macro-ent;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item code="i2">&complex;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Second &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT sub-sec (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction data="some value here"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.com/doc" xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns">
  <!-- Comment preceding namespaced content -->
  <ns:sub-sec>
    <![CDATA[
      Namespaced CDATA section with special chars: <>&"'
    ]]>
  </ns:sub-sec>
  <section>&ent2;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e-acute "é">
  <!ENTITY author "Author Name">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ref 'MacroContent'>">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <file>
    <![CDATA[
      File contents with entity &e-acute; and CDATA markers.
    ]]>
  </file>
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata CDATA block. Written by &author;.
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task*)>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY task-name "Important Task">
  <!ENTITY % structure "
    <!ELEMENT subtask (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY subtask-ent 'Subtask Entity'>
  ">
  %structure;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
<project xmlns="http://example.org/project" xmlns:p="http://example.org/project/params">
  <!-- Task list comment -->
  <task>
    <![CDATA[
      Task details: &task-name;
    ]]>
  </task>
  <p:subtask>
    <![CDATA[
      Subtask CDATA: &subtask-ent;
    ]]>
  </p:subtask>
</project>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item-ref "Standard Item">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % inventory-macro "<!ATTLIST item id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %inventory-macro;
]>
<?xml-header-pi option="enabled"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inventory" xmlns:inv="http://example.org/inventory/ns">
  <!-- Inventory section comment -->
  <inv:item id="item1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA inside inventory item: &item-ref;
    ]]>
  </inv:item>
  <item id="item2">&item-ref;</item>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY conf-val "Production">
  <!ENTITY % p-entity "<!ENTITY sec-ent 'Secondary'>">
  %p-entity;
]>
<?xml-meta author="admin" date="2024-01-01"?>
<config xmlns="http://example.org/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.org/config/extended">
  <!-- Configuration parameters comment -->
  <setting>
    <![CDATA[
      Environment: &conf-val;
    ]]>
  </setting>
  <cfg:setting>
    <![CDATA[
      Secondary Environment: &sec-ent;
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
</config>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY book-title "XML Parsing Techniques">
  <!NOTATION xml-notif SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY sample-doc SYSTEM "sample.xml" NDATA xml-notif>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-extension "
    <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY author-name 'John Doe'>
  ">
  %dtd-extension;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="print.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<library xmlns="http://example.org/library" xmlns:lib="http://example.org/library/ns">
  <!-- Library catalog comment -->
  <lib:book>
    <![CDATA[
      Book review for &book-title; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </lib:book>
  <author>&author-name;</author>
</library>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE log [
  <!ELEMENT log (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY log-level "INFO">
  <!ENTITY full-log "[&log-level;] System operational">
  <!ENTITY % log-macro "<!ELEMENT timestamp (#PCDATA)>">
  %log-macro;
]>
<?xml-audit state="verified" user="system"?>
<log xmlns="http://example.org/log" xmlns:audit="http://example.org/log/audit">
  <!-- Log start comment with hyphens -- inside -->
  <entry>
    <![CDATA[
      Log message body with entities: &full-log;
    ]]>
  </entry>
  <audit:timestamp>
    <![CDATA[
      2024-06-01T00:00:00Z
    ]]>
  </audit:timestamp>
</log>
